issue_context.title: Migrate HashCodeCombiner to existing hashing helper code
issue_context.body:
With the addition of the Microsoft.Extensions libraries, we've added another "hashing helper" type to our repo:

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/327801e8b838b97950cb8daaeef724acbe4e3c5f/src/libraries/Common/src/Extensions/HashCodeCombiner/HashCodeCombiner.cs#L11

We should move all usages of this to one of the existing "hashing helper" options we already have.

review_comments:
How do we confirm the two logics yield the same results? Was going to recommend we move the two removed tests to where tests for HashHelpers live but could not find where `src\libraries\System.Private.CoreLib\src\System\Numerics\Hashing\HashHelpers.cs` tests are placed.

cc: @tannergooding
I don't know if we had any tests for it, it was an internal helper type.

> How do we confirm the two logics yield the same results?

GetHashCode doesn't need to return the exact same results across versions. It just needs to return the same results for 2 logically equivalent objects.
Do we have good test coverage for edge-cases of Equals/GetHashCode to make sure they agree?  Not seeing anything that stands out as buggy here but want to understand how much we should scrutinize.

StringValues has pretty good test coverage for GetHashCode, even edge-cases:

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/6072e4d3a7a2a1493f514cdf4be75a3d56580e84/src/libraries/Microsoft.Extensions.Primitives/tests/StringValuesTests.cs#L588-L612

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/6072e4d3a7a2a1493f514cdf4be75a3d56580e84/src/libraries/Microsoft.Extensions.Primitives/tests/StringValuesTests.cs#L93-L117

I didn't see any real tests for FilePatternMatch.GetHashCode, so I added a couple.
